cohort: The study included all live-born breech singletons between 23 and 27 weeks of gestation from 2010 to 2022, who received active resuscitation, excluding outborn infants and those with major congenital anomalies.
finding: Cesarean delivery for extremely preterm breech singletons was associated with a reduction in mortality or severe morbidity.
mod_finding: The adjusted incidence of mortality or severe morbidity was lower in the cesarean delivery group (26.1%) compared to the vaginal birth group (33.7%).
